correctness.rationale: On G_N=(Z/N)^2 with support {0,+/-e1,+/-e2,+/-(e1-e2)}, positive definiteness iff all Fourier modes nonnegative. Sixfold lattice symmetry average reduces optimal mass to 1+6a with 1+2aS_N(u,v)>=0; balanced-three-gap minimization gives sigma_N and T_N=1-3/sigma_N. Strict gap-smoothing identity, with the exceptional (0,N/2,N/2) even-order case handled by second shift, identifies all two or six minima for every N>=5. Every optimizer vanishes at each minimizing Fourier contact; in nonresonant orders the 3-by-3 cosine and sine coefficient matrices are separately invertible, proving unique complex optimizer. If 3|N only two real constraints remain and invariant optimum is strictly positive off contacts, giving relative dimension four. Expansion near equilateral phases gives correct signed N^-3 residue term. Independent Fourier LP for 19 small N matches exact masses and contact/optimizer constraints; finite checking not used to prove all-order claims.
